about.title: Let Ain Soukhna Magic Renew Your Spirit
about.description:
Crystal water with gentle waves of the Red Sea, deep-sea fishing, and a relaxing environment are what you need to pick some rest and revive energy. Ain Soukhna enjoys a splendid moderate atmosphere throughout the year and is not limited to a specific season. You can enjoy spending your holidays at any time of the year.
Surrounded by premier environmental and attraction locations on the Red Sea, Stella Di Mare Grand Hotel at Ain Soukhna has its remarkable destination to unwind, stress-relieving, and enjoy the sceneries of sea and sun as well.

details.title: Oasis Restaurant
details.fullDescription: Royal Continental features dining options to satisfy your culinary needs 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, whether you choose to select from our extensive in-room dining menu, or one of our two outlets. Oasis Restaurant Deira, Dubai, our all-day dining venue, offering sumptuous multi-cuisine buffets for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Royal Continental Hotel reflects and upholds Arab cultural values throughout its facilities, and therefore does not serve any alcoholic beverages or pork items.

facility.heading: Outdoor swimming pool and sun deck

details.title: Swimming Pool
details.fullDescription: The Swimming Pool at Royal Continental Hotel is the perfect oasis for those seeking a tranquil escape after a hectic day. Nestled on the pool deck level, this serene spot boasts stunning views and a laid-back atmosphere that instantly puts you at ease. As you kick off your shoes and dip your toes into the refreshing water, you can unwind to the soothing sounds of chilled lounge music playing in the background. Sip on delicious mocktails or smoothies as you bask in the warm sun, indulging in fresh fruit and snacks to keep you energized. And when hunger strikes, tantalize your taste buds with mouth-watering food options that are sure to satisfy any craving. The Swimming Pool at Royal Continental Hotel provides a luxurious haven where you can truly unwind and recharge amidst luxury surroundings.

As you enter the café, you are greeted by friendly baristas who expertly craft your favorite espresso-based beverages with precision and care. The cozy seating area offers a relaxing space to enjoy your drink while soaking in the vibrant energy of this bustling coffee shop.

details.title: Fitness Center
details.fullDescription: The Gym at Royal Continental Hotel offers guests the perfect opportunity to stay active and fit while away from home. Equipped with modern technology and a variety of exercise equipment, this gym is designed to help you achieve clear and effective results. Whether you prefer cardio workouts, strength training with free weights, running on machines, or using resistance equipment, there is something for everyone here. With top-of-the-line facilities and dedicated staff members ready to assist you in reaching your fitness goals, staying healthy during your stay has never been easier at the Gym at Royal Continental Hotel.

Escape to one of the premier five-star hotel & resort at Naama Bay, soak in our spectacular private beach, and indulge in exquisite restaurants of your choice. As you can enjoy a walk to town center or ask for our free shuttle bus service.
While Stella Di Mare Beach Hotel & Spa Egypt is well known for its hospitality, there are many other activities available ranging from energetic programs to more leisurely quests.
We have the information you’ll need to discover Red Sea reefs while enjoying diving and snorkeling.

details.title: Rooms with Dubai Canal View
details.fullDescription: Experience the ultimate luxury living at Royal Continental Suites, where you can have an amazing Canal View with Burj Khalifa as your backdrop. Imagine waking up to the stunning sight of the iconic Dubai skyline right outside your window. Royal Continental Suites offers a stunning choice for travelers seeking a hotel apartment with a canal view. This property features elegantly designed accommodations that overlook the picturesque canal, providing guests with a serene and scenic backdrop. Each hotel apartment with a canal view at Royal Continental Suites is thoughtfully appointed to ensure maximum comfort and luxury, allowing guests to enjoy both the beauty of the water and the convenience of modern amenities. Whether you’re staying for business or leisure, the breathtaking canal views enhance the experience, making Royal Continental Suites a standout choice for those seeking a memorable stay.

At Royal Continental Suites, guests can enjoy access to the luxurious Royal GYM services. This state-of-the-art fitness center offers top-of-the-line equipment and amenities for those looking to stay active during their stay. From cardio machines to free weights, there is something for every type of workout enthusiast.

facility.heading: Witness The Beauty Of Waterfront Views

details.fullDescription: At Babati, our mission is to bring a unique interpretation of Lebanese cuisine to Dubai. Located in Business Bay with mesmerizing views of the Dubai Water Canal, our restaurant in Dubai is a dining destination that offers a taste of true Levantine cuisine with its characteristic blend of fresh herbs and flavorful spices. Lebanese cuisine has always found its unique place in the broader umbrella of Levantine cuisine. Our chefs have made it their mission to bring out the charm of Lebanese cuisine using modern techniques and high-quality ingredients. Acquaint your tastebuds with a plethora of flavours and textures that you have never enjoyed before!
